messages:
Sam R: Tiki Terrace boardgame + tiki cocktails this Thurs after work? rooftop at 6:30. bring a snack to share. :tropical_drink: :game_die:
Ada C: love it! I can bring mango mocktails (and a little rum for anyone who wants). :yum:
Kevin M: I'm so in. can someone bring Settlers or Wingspan?
Nora L: I can bring Wingspan and give a quick how-to. small speaker too.
Ben T: I'll handle snacks — thinking pizza slices + chips. can also bring Uno for quick rounds.
Sam R: awesome. Quick poll — what start time works: 6:00 / 6:30 / 7:00?
Lunchbot: Poll created: "Start time" — Options: 6:00, 6:30, 7:00. Current votes: 6:30 (3), 6:00 (1).
Ada C: 6:30 works best for me.
Kevin M: 6:30 from me too.
Nora L: 6:30 — perfect to do a 20min Wingspan intro at 6:45.
Sam R: locking 6:30 then. RSVP here and shout out any dietary restrictions.
Ben T: gluten-free options are fine — I'll pick GF crackers and a GF pizza slice.
Ada C: also can we run a tiki-themed playlist? adding this: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/xyz
Sam R: love the playlist. I'll bring some foam coasters & tiki napkins. :palm_tree:
Kevin M: rooftop outlets are flaky — i'll bring a small power bank/usb speaker + flashlight in case.
Sam R: if it rains we'll move to 3rd-floor lounge and keep the same plan.
Nora L: happy to run the Wingspan intro at 6:45 so people can jump in.
Ben T: can someone volunteer to grab ice? i'm walking from home and can swing by otherwise.
Ada C: I can grab ice on my way in — what quantity? a couple of bags?
Sam R: two bags should do it. thanks Ada!
Kevin M: bringing a tiny cardholder for score tokens.
Sam R: excellent. See y'all Thu 6:30 — tiki shirts optional but encouraged :tada:
